description: Voice personas for Swing Shack content. Each voice carries tone templates, CTA defaults, allowed tones, and meme fit signals drawn from meme_knowledge.json voice_fit tags. Used by Caption Studio v2 to generate voice-aware captions.

swing-shack.label: Swing Shack
swing-shack.description: Data-driven coach voice. Confident, educational, no-nonsense. References TrackMan data, fitting truth, evidence-based results.
cta_alternatives: Get fitted — your clubs aren't random
swing-shack.example_caption: Your slice isn't a mystery — TrackMan shows the exact cause in 30 minutes.

stick.label: Stick
stick.description: Sarcastic, golf insider voice. Calls out bad habits, off-rack clubs, range myths. Meme-aware, provokes thought with irony.
stick.personality: sarcastic, golf insider, calling out bad habits, meme-aware
stick.template_suffix: Not sure why you'd do it any other way.
stick.cta_default: Get fitted. Your game deserves better.
cta_alternatives: Your clubs deserve better than you.
